articles.title: Broadcaster Dave Reynolds was spirit of Cape Breton radio and hockey telecasts
articles.description: Cohort pay tribute to Dave Reynolds, whose career spanned radio and television from the 1960s until the late 2000s, including two stints at CJCB-AM (1967-69 and 1981-90) and on CBC's Hockey Night in Canada (1973-76). He died on Wednesday in Truro at age 82.
